verdict.rationale: React documents hydrateRoot for attaching to server-generated HTML (react-docs-9). It also documents streaming HTML from the server, progressively filling in content before any JavaScript loads (react-docs-6). Together these cover server-rendered hydration and progressive streaming, but nothing says hydration itself happens progressively or selectively so parts of the page become interactive sooner. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of progressive/selective hydration (e.g. Suspense-boundary hydration ordering), evidence of time-to-interactive benefits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
